README_STATUS: The repository has a C++20 native foundation linked to Cellerator, with supplied-system execution, observations, finite joint alternatives, selected response/interrogation tools and replay/binding paths. These components make supplied alternatives executable and interrogable without committing to a universal biological model. The broader learning layer remains under development; existing synthetic checks are not biological discoveries.
README_RESULTS: The existing complete-program record exercises supplied candidates, forward calculations, selected responses, observation and inference together. It reports cold and finite-resident lifecycle costs for five bounded cases rather than claiming a universal speedup.

BUILD_COMMANDS:
```sh
# Point to a qualified Cellerator installation containing native_foundation
# and indexed_mechanism, not just its host compiler SDK.
cmake -S . -B build-docs -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="${CELLERATOR_PREFIX}" -DBUILD_TESTING=ON
cmake --build build-docs -j 4
ctest --test-dir build-docs -N
```

The inspected configuration requires CMake 3.28, C++20, Cellerator package components, CUDAToolkit and LAPACK; test configuration enables CUDA. Inspect the generated test list and run CPU/GPU subsets under the correct resources. `gh_nf1a_complete_program` is the current bounded CUDA executable; its replay belongs to the evidence task, not every README edit. Optional Python bindings require the configured Python development module. Requalify commands after the pending ML2 work.
